description: This file defines the NotesListFragment class, which manages displaying a list of notes, handling user interactions such as searching, navigating to editing notes, and updating the UI based on live data streams.

classes.name: NotesListFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a list of notes, supports searching with debounce, and navigation to note editing screens.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and returns the root view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the adapter, navigation, search listener, and collects note data to update UI.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up binding when view is destroyed.
